sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:41

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:41:1
items.html:
Comprised of all ten Sefirot, but the matter was in a mixture: That is, that through the restriction of NHY, etc., the correction of the ten vessels had already been made, as above; meaning that phase four became mingled in each and every Sefira because of her joining with phase two. And then the discernment of a screen and a coupling was corrected in each and every Sefira, up to Hochma and up to the Nikvey Einayim, as above. However, this correction was only in the GAR of the Nekudim. But in the ZAT of the Nekudim — although there too the discernment of the joining of phase two with phase four ruled, for those vessels are the discernment of the vessels of the nine lower Sefirot of SAG, in which this joining was the main thing, and there phase two was thickened by the force of their illumination in the inner ZON of AK, as above, page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG,” and therefore the ZAT received that doubled discernment of coarseness first — yet it was in them without correction. Rather, they were merely mingled one with the other, like the mixture of liquid with liquid that the ARI brings; meaning that the discernments of the judgments alone, and the discernment of the mercies alone, and the like, were not recognisable, but everything was mingled together indistinguishably. And from this mixture, discernments of shells also came into being there, in the secret of the dross of the gold and the lees of the wine, and they too were mingled in those vessels indistinguishably, as he goes on to write.
And you must understand in this whole matter that although the discernment of coarseness in the vessels is their entire greatness and praise, by which the whole height of their level is measured, indeed all this is so only if they have the correction of a screen equal to that measure of coarseness. But if they do not have that correction of the screen which ought to be set against that coarseness, then the coarseness turns over and becomes harsh and bitter judgments in them; for disparity of form is separation in spirituality, and therefore they cannot nurse their measure of vitality from the upper light, and then the coarseness becomes discernments of judgments and shells, that is, discernments of harsh harmful forces, until they receive their full corrections.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:41:2
items.html: The existence of the world and its governance are impossible without judgments and shells. Since the governance of the world is according to the thought of creation, which is to delight His creatures, that is, in order to give a good reward to the righteous. And such governance cannot exist except by means of the work, in the secret of “God has made one opposite the other.” And therefore a place was prepared for the existence of judgments and shells.
